gen-dafont-groovy-gf-kedebideri: Kedebideri reads soft and open, rounded letters rising on a tall x-height, while the heading font Groovy pinches its c nearly shut. Over a full page, that plain sans stays friendly and easy going.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-khula: Funky and loose, Groovy leads with a nearly closed c. Khula follows in sans-serif with a tall midsection and curves that hold their mouths open, so paragraphs glide along without snagging.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-krub: Constant-width arms and legs give Groovy a bent-paperclip look. Krub, a sans-serif with a pronounced x-height and unfinished loops, supplies the open, contemporary counterweight to all that closed-up funk.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-kufam: Neon-tube strokes of a single width, plus generous curves in the e, give this body a smooth glide. Kufam keeps paragraphs smooth and contemporary, while Groovy stays loose, friendly and nearly shut at the c.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-lexend: Oversized lowercase and open jaws on every curve make this body read big and friendly. Lexend holds its thickness steady around curves, so paragraphs stay comfortable beside the pinched letters of Groovy.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-lexend-deca: Groovy brings a funky, loosely tracked heading with a slit where the c almost closes. But Lexend Deca, a sans-serif with unshaded lines and large lowercase, opens everything back up.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-liter: Liter is a modern sans-serif with no stroke contrast, tall lowercase and wide mouths on its round forms. Groovy does the funky showing off, while Liter does the tall-standing text work.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-mada: Curves that refuse to close and a towering midzone give this plain sans an approachable, modern feel. Mada then gives Groovy, with its loose tracking and constant-width arms, an open counterpart to lean on.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-martel-sans: Every curve opens generously and the mean line sits high, so this sans-serif carries words with ease. Martel Sans is the one for steady text, while Groovy is the one for loose, friendly attitude.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-matangi: Contemporary and hefty, Matangi lays down twine-like strokes and open rounded letters beneath the funky, nearly closed Groovy. Tight, funky letters up top, open sans below: that is the draw.
